Never let a line containing 'ROUNDED', 'ROUNDING', 'ADJ' override an earlier clean inclusive-GST total."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Number pattern allows 1-decimal amounts, enabling OCR truncation errors (88.1→88.10). Replace with an explicit multi-pass policy: (a) run raw-image OCR AND grayscale+autocontrast+upscale OCR, (b) for each field extract (tier_index, value, decimal_digits) tuples from every pass, (c) choose by lowest tier_index, then highest decimal_digits (==2 preferred), then by cross-pass agreement count, then by earliest in-text position. Document this as the mandatory arbitration rule."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction section does not describe sanity-checking or digit-confusion recovery. If still invalid, return None."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No currency/thousands-separator normalization guidance beyond 'strip commas'. Note cost/latency trade-off.","generalizes":"Any receipt/form extraction where Tesseract is unreliable"},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add an 'Exact-match tabular outputs' subsection: single sheet with specified name, exact header text and order, lex-sorted rows, string columns preserved as object dtype, None (empty cell) for missing values, no formatting, no formulas, no extra sheets.
